tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /rgyal dbang kun dga' rin chen gyi rnam par thar pa zhus lan dkar chag ma zhes bya ba bzhugs so// /gang zhig thog mtha' dbus bral zhing*// brjed sogs rkyen las nges grol bas// lhun grub bsam mi khyab pa'i dbyings// khyab bdag chos kyi rje la 'dud// yon tan gzhal du ma mchis zhing*// thugs rje tshad du med pa yi// phrin las mkha' dang mnyam pa nyid// skyob pa thugs rje can la bstod// gang de'i mdzad phrin dpag dka' las// cha shas brjod dang mthong ba dang*// bka' yi ji ltar bstsal ba sogs// sngon chad tshul rnams thugs rje yi// 'od kyi khyab par mdzad pa ltar// lug gi lo 'dzin yan chad kyi// rnam thar sngar bkod de bzhin du// de nas da lta'i bar dag gi// phyi nang mdzad pa dpag dka' rnams// ji ltar mdzad dang lhag lha dang*// bla ma bka' yi srung ma yi// mtshan rtags ji ltar byung ba dang*// khyad par 'dzam gling rten gyi mchog /bkra shis sgo mang dbu btsugs nas// mngon par grub dang rab gnas dang*// bkra shis dga' ston yongs rdzogs kyis// sprul sku rdo rje rgyal po sogs// ji ltar 'dod pa'i re skong ba'i// dus kyi rtags dang mtshan ma dang*// nyams dang rmi lam la sogs kyi// byung tshul rnam thar ri mo zhig /bka' drin dam pa bskyang du gsol// bdag kyang skye dang skye bar yang*// khyod zhabs padmor gus bsten zhing*// khyod bstan dri med rgyas byed dang*// khyod bzhin 'gro ba sgrol bar shog /ces rgyal ba kun gyi ngo bo/ rgyal dbang kun dga'i mtshan can gyi mdzad pa rlabs po che la spro ba dang*/ khyad par rten mchog bkra shis sgo mang mngon par grub dus/ ched du ngo mtshar ba'i rnam thar gyi zhu ba/ snyan pa'i sgra dbyangs zhes pa phul ba'o// ༈ //oṃ bde legs su gyur cig dpag yas bskal par tshogs gnyis rab rdzogs shing*// rnam 'dren byang chub snying po shākya'i tog /phrin las 'od kyi tsha zer 'phro ba can// thub dbang nyi ma'i mgon po spyi bos mchod// 'di las yang 'phros gzhung lugs bod du 'byed// klu sgrub mgon zhes nyi zla ltar grags pa// drug brgya'i mar 'tsho bstan pa gsal bar mdzad// 'phags mchog gnyis pa de'i zhabs spyi bos mchod// rgyal ba'i bstan la rgyal ba'i mdzad pa skyong*// rgyal sras klu sgrub snying po'i nying sprul mchog

/thog med dus nas dang por sangs rgyas pa// zla bral 'jig rten gsum mgon spyi bos 'dud// de yi bka' dang gdams pa ma lus pa// rnam dpyod blo yi bum par rab gtams nas// srid zhi'i rgud pa bsal mdzad sku bzhi'i bdag /mnyam med ratna rā dza'i zhabs pad 'dud// ces mchod par brjod pa dang*/ bka' drin dran pa dang*/ bla na med pa'i mdzad pa rlabs po che dag la/ yang dag par slob par 'dod pa dang*/ rnam par thar pa'i yul la 'jug pa dang*/ spyod yul du gyur pa'i sems bskyed pa/ smon lam brgya phrag du ma yang dag par brjod pa dang*/ 'bras bu mi dmigs pa'i sngo ba theb par 'dod pa'i phyir du/ rten mchog bkra shis sgo mang ratna tsarya'i mchod rten chen po bzhengs shing*/ bstan pa'i bya ba rlabs po che bsgrubs pa dag la/ yang dag par smon pa'i lhag bsam rnam par dag pa skyes shing*/ grangs med du mar bsod nams dang ye shes kyi dpal la spyad cing*/ mang du thos zhing lung dang rtogs pa rgya mtsho'i pha rol tu son pa/ snyigs ma'i dus 'dir mgon po 'bri gung pa'i bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan bzung nas/ sems can dpag tu med pa'i rnam mang nye 'tsho'i gzhir gyur pa/ bla ma yang dag pa'i bshes gnyen de nyid kyis/ kho bo cag gi phyi nang gsang gsum gyis rnam thar lug lo yan sngon chad grub pa'i 'phros la brten te/ da lta'i bar gyi phyi nang gi mdzad pa dpag dka' ba rnams ji ltar bsgrubs shing*/ lhag pa'i lha dang*/ bla ma'i bka' dang*/ srung ma'i snang ba thob pa dang*/ rtags mtshan khyad par 'dzam gling rten mchog rnams kyi nang nas rgyal mtshan gyi tog ltar mngon par mtho ba/ bkra shis sgo mang dbu btsugs nas yongs su rdzogs par grub pa'i bar dang rab tu gnas pa phyi nang gzhan gsum na/ dga' ston/ sprul sku rdo rje rgyal po la sogs pa rig byed pa rnams kyi yon rdzongs sogs legs par shis pa'i dge mtshan/

dngos su rtags dang*/ nyams sam/ rmi lam byung tshul rgyas par bkod de/ bdag sogs dad can dang ba 'dren zhing ma 'ongs pa'i dus su/ bstan pa'i gsal byed du 'gro ba gang zhig mngon par stsal du gsol/ bdag kyang skye dang skye bar yang*// khyod zhabs padmor gus bsten zhing*// khyod bstan dri med rgyas byed dang*// khyod bzhin 'gro ba sgrol byed shog /rgyal ba kun gyi ngo bo rgyal dbang kun dga'i mtshan can gyis/ mdzad pa rlabs po che la spro ba dang*/ khyad par thugs dam bzhengs pa'i rtags mtshan ngo mtshar ba'i rnam thar gyi zhu ba snyan pa'i sgra dbyangs kyis bskul ba'i ngor/ lan du med pa spangs nas 'di ltar brjod par byed de/ de la khyad gzhi dang*/ khyad chos kyi rnam par bshad pa dag las/ dang po khyad gzhi ni/ sngon bskal pa dpag tu med pa 'das pa'i sngon rol na/ rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul du rgyal po 'od zer go chas sngon ma grags shing 'gro ba bsod nams gsog pa'i rten bzhengs dgongs pa las/ lhas lung bstan te/ phyi mchod rten gyi rnam pa la nang gzhal yas khang gi tshul du yod pa'i nang*/ 'das pa'i sangs rgyas mar me mdzad/ ma 'ongs pa'i sangs rgyas dga' ldan nas byams pa mgon po/ da ltar gyi sangs rgyas shākya thub pa gsum gyi rten bzhugs pa'i/ gser 'bum 'dzam gling rgyan bzhengs pa/ jo bo rjes bod du gdan drangs/ bka' gdams brgya rtsa brgyad kyi mgo bo byang rwa sgreng du bzhugs pa/ snyigs dus kyi rgyal ba gnyis pa 'gro ba'i mgon po phag mo gru pa yab sras kyis 'bri gdan 'og min gyi gnas su spyan drangs/ da lta dpal 'bri gung du rten gyi gtso bor bzhugs pa dang*/ bar gyi bskal pa 'di nyid du/ rje 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon pos rgya bod du ma grags shing 'gro ba bsod nams gsog pa'i rten ci lta bu zhig bzhengs dgongs pa las/ shar dwags lha sgam po'i dbus su/ gdar gyi ri la phebs pas ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma til gyi gang bu kha phye ba lta bus/

lho gnas mchog dpal gyi tsā ri tra ye shes kyi 'khor lo'i dag pa shel ri rten mchog bkra shis sgo mang gzigs snang gtan la phebs te/ bzhengs par mdzad pa dag las bgyis te/ khyad chos 'di bzhengs pa'o// de yang lha dang bla ma'i snang ba thob tshul ni/ sngon gyi dus su 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon por ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyis snang ba sbyin pa dpe brjod du byas shing*/ da lta'i skabs su sgo mang 'di nyid bzhengs pa'i sa gzhi byin rlabs dang*/ bzo thig blangs pa'i nyin/ lha rnams kyi 'ja'i gur dang*/ mthil nas bla brang mtshe'u kha'i bar 'ja' tshon gyis 'brel ba dang*/ me tog dang*/ me tog gi khang bu brtsegs pa dang*/ spos kyi ngad ldang ba sogs las khyad par can dag la'o// bla mas gnang ba byin pa ni/ mnyam pa med pa'i bdag cag gi yongs 'dzin mtshungs med rgyal dbang rin chen chos kyi rgyal po de nyid kyis lan gcig ma yin par 'gro ba bsod nams gsog pa'i rten bzhengs pa dang*/ gsung bri ba dang*/ bstan pa'i sgron me dag la slobs shig ces bkas bskul ba dang*/ rang res ri mor bris pa dang*/ 'bur du dod pa dang*/ lugs su blugs pa chung ngu tsam sbyin pa la'ang ched du bsngags shing*/ bye brag tu'ang*/ bla brang mtshe'u kha'i mgon khang rnying ma dag la gso ba'i dam bca' phul bas/ rab tu bsngags pa mdzad pa yongs 'dzin shrī dbang ratna'i zhal mnga' nas/ bdag spun gyis spangs phu'i gnas su chos zhus/ de'i tshe de'i dus bdag cag gi zhu ba 'di ltar bgyis te/ nged kyi nu bo chos kyi rgyal po 'di la phrin las ji ltar 'byung zhus pas/ 'di la ci yang mi 'byung*/ khyod rang gis ma 'ongs pa na/ rten bzhengs pa bstan pa'i bya ba rlabs po che grub par byed do zhes gsungs pa rnams dang*/ de'i 'phros la khyod nyid kyi khu bo rgyal ba dbang rin po che'i gdul bya rnams kyi phyag rdzas rnams rang rang gis spyod yul du byas kyang*/

da lta thub chen dang bstan 'gyur bzhengs pa rnams grub pa thob pa'i rtags su mngon no// zhes gsungs pa sogs kyi gnang ba byin pa'o// bka' sdod srung mas rjes su bzung ba dpag tu med cing*/ dmigs su bsal na/ lha khang chen mor sbrul lo zla ba gsum pa'i nyin gcig la bzo thab btsugs pa'i bka' gtad dang po dag la/ rang re dang dpon mo che/ gzhi mthun du nyams sam/ rmi lam dag las/ a phyi chos kyi sgron ma gtso 'khor lnga tshan gcig gis gtsos pa'i mkha' 'gro dpag tu med pas rab tu gnas pa mdzad cing*/ bar du gcod pa dag las rgyal ces gsung gi snang ba sbyin pa dag kyang nges so// de rnams la brten te rten mchog 'di sgrub ste/ thog mar nyi zla bya ru dang bcas pa la/ chos rje bla ma'i dngul sku nas bzung ste/ bka' brgyud bla ma'i bang rim dag la gtso bo phyogs bzhir khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang gis gtsos pa'i grub chen brgyad cu/ da lta'i rtsa ba'i bla ma rnams kyi bar dang*/ rdo rje'i cod pan la 'khor lo bde mchog sku bzhi rigs bzhi mkha' 'gros bskor ba/ yum rdo rje rnal 'byor chen mo bcu gnyis/ zur la mi g.yo ba bzhi rnams bzhugs/ gnyis pa bla med bang rim la/ gsang sngags rnying ma'i lha tshogs gtso bo slob dpon padma'i sku/ bla ma zhi drag mtshan brgyad/ mtsho skyes rdo rje la sogs kyis gtsos pa'i sgrub pa bka' brgyad gtso 'khor tshang ba/ gsar ma'i lha tshogs/ gtso bo/ bde dgyes/ dus gsang*/ gshed dmar/ dgra nag 'jigs byed/ tshe dpag ma hā ma ya/ sangs rgyas bde skyong*/ bde mchog gtsug nor gtso 'khor sogs gsang sngags gsar rnying bla med tshang bar bzhugs/ rnal 'byor rgyud kyis gtso bo bcom ldan 'das kun rig rdor dbyings/ sangs rgyas thod pa/ yum bcas/ yum chen mo/ sangs rgyas sman pa'i rgyal po/ mi 'khrug mgon po/ khro rgyal rme rtsegs/ spyod rgyud kyi gtso bo/ bcom ldan 'das thub pa chen po bzhi/

'phags pa'i gnas brtan bcu drug sogs bzhugs/ bya rgyud kyi gtso bo/ ri khrod lo ma can ma/ phyag brgyad sgrol ma rigs bdag dang bcas pa/ rgyal mtshan rtse mo'i dpung rgyan/ lha mo nor rgyun ma sogs kyi lha tshogs/ drug pa yas pad mas khri'i pad 'dab chen mo'i bang rim bdun pa padma'i ldum rdzings chen po la/ chos skyong gtso bo gter mgon yum bcas dpal mgon phyag bzhi pa/ gur gyi mgon po/ mgon po phyag drug pa/ mgon po legs ldan/ mgon po ber nag mgon po gri gug mgon po trag shad/ rnam sras ser chen/ a phyi chos kyi sgron ma/ rgyal chen bzhi sogs bzhugs/ yongs su bsgril bar lha nyis stong brgyad brgya tshang bar bzhugs pa rnams/ legs par grub pa'i rtags mtshan/ bkra shis pa'i dge mtshan byung tshul/ gnas skabs su phrin las bzhi grub pa/ mthar thug mchog sku bzhi thob pa rnams te/ dang por zhi ba'i las grub tshul ni/ rten mchog 'di dbu btsugs nas bzung ste/ bdud dang spang bya mtha' dag nam mkha' la sprin dengs pa bzhin du zhi ste/ dgra bgegs kyi tshogs rnams dbang du 'dus shing phyi nang gi bar chad dag las grol bar byas pa'o// rgyas pa'i las grub tshul ni/ rten mchog sgrub pa'i mthun rkyen thams cad rdzogs ldan gyi sprin bzhin du 'dus shing dgos 'dod thams cad yid bzhin du 'grub par gyur cing*/ zang zing dang yo byad kha na ma tho ba med pa rnams dang*/ chos srid dar zhing bshad sgrub kyi bstan pa nyin mor byed pa'i 'phrin las rgyas pa dag la'o// dbang gi 'bras bu grub tshul ni/ 'khor 'das gnyis la dbang bsgyur cing*/ de la gzhan gyis dring 'jog du med pa'i dbang phyug phun sum tshogs pa ma tshang ba med pa thob par byas pa dag la'o// drag po'i phrin las grub tshul ni/ phas kyi rgol ba thams cad kyis rnam par bdo ba med pa dang*/ rnam par 'tshe ba med/ kun la rang bzhin gyis snyoms pa/

chos kyi rgyal srid rab tu brtan zhing*/ zla ba dgra las rnam par rgyal bar gyur pa lta bu rnams so// mchog sku bzhi thob tshul ni/ phyi sprul pa'i sku rnams bzhengs pas/ 'bras bu mchog gi sprul pa rgyal ba shākya thub pa 'grub/ nang longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku rnams bzhengs pas longs sku rnam par snang mdzad zhing khams thams cad la skus khyab cing sku la zhing khams thams cad snang ba bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad 'grub/ gsang ba chos kyi sku rnams bzhengs pas chos sku rdo rje 'chang chen po kha sbyor yan lag bdun ldan nam dbang phyug brgyad ldan 'grub/ de kho na nyid kyi sku/ sku bcas sku ni med pa yis// mchod rten chen po rab bzhengs pas/ snang gsum gcig tu 'dus pa'i dpal// sku bzhi'i ngo bo nyid 'grub bo// de ltar mchog dang thun mong dngos grub mthong chos su grub pa'i rtags dang mtshan ma rnams la yid ches pa'i gdeng thob par bya'o/// /

'di ltar 'khor 'das kyi yon tan rin po che'i 'byung gnas/ thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa thob pa'i rtsa lag tu gyur cing*/ 'gro ba bsod nams gsog pa'i rten mchog 'di nyid sbrul gyi lo'i zla ba gsum pa nas brtsams te/ rta'i lo dang*/ lug gi lo dang*/ spre'u'i lo dang*/ bya'i lo'i nang du legs par grub par byas pa'i zhu lan dkar chag ma zhes yongs su grags pa 'di nyid/ bstan 'dzin bsod nams rgya mtsho'i ming can gyis bskul ba'i ngor/ 'bri gung spyan snga ā nanda ratna shrī bha dras shing mo bya'i yar tshes bzang po la 'bri gung 'og min gyi gtsug lag khang chen por sbyar ba'i dge bas rdo rje 'chang chen po thob par gyur cig// /maṅga laṃ/// /
